requirements.requirement: The system must render recruiting status before any other triage or quality information in the MessageBubble component.
The system must render condition match immediately after recruiting status and before any quality metrics.
The system must display a clear pass or fail indicator for the trial triage result.
The system must render a human-readable explanation string describing why the trial passed or failed triage.
The system must ensure that quality metrics, if present, are rendered only after recruiting status and condition match sections.
The system must visually distinguish pass vs fail states using consistent UI indicators (e.g., color, icon, or label).
The system must render recruiting status using normalized labels (e.g., Recruiting, Not Recruiting, Unknown) based on the frontend contract.
The system must render condition match as a clear affirmative or negative indicator (e.g., Matches your condition / Does not match).
The system must not render triage content if the triage data contract from S1 is absent or invalid.
The system must render a fallback message indicating unavailable triage information when required fields are missing.
The system must gracefully handle missing explanation text by rendering a default explanation message.
The system must ensure that rendering logic is deterministic such that identical triage inputs always produce identical UI ordering and content.
The system must not interleave triage explanation elements with unrelated chat content within the same MessageBubble.
The system must render triage sections in a consistent vertical order across all trials regardless of data variation.
